prompt_policy: Contact only when right hand/fingers/palm visibly touches or holds the object; near/ambiguous is false.

decisions.reason: The person's right hand is reaching but remains visibly separated from the scanner/base; no touch or grasp is shown.
The right hand is reaching but remains far from the scanner/base with a visible gap; no physical contact is visible.
The person's right hand is hovering/reaching toward the scanner with a clear visible gap and no touch.
The person's right hand is reaching toward the object but remains visibly separated with a clear gap.
The person's right hand is near/approaching the scanner but there is a visible gap and no clear touching or grasping.
The person's right hand is reaching toward the scanner but there is a visible gap and no clear physical touch.
Right hand is hovering near the scanner, but no clear visible physical contact or overlap is shown.
The person's right fingers visibly overlap and press against the pink scanner, indicating clear contact.
Right fingers are close to the scanner but no clear visible touching or grasping is shown.
Right fingers are hovering near the scanner with a visible gap and no clear physical touch.
The person's right fingers visibly overlap/occlude the upper pink scanner with no clear gap, indicating contact.
